scope: Read-only fixed-candidate dynamic checks and actual consumed-reference evidence; no new experiment.

full_speed_and_half_speed_dynamic_checks.scope: Unchanged candidate and same frozen CV. Dynamic hard sphere margin only, not full native acceptance.
Unchanged candidate and same frozen CV. Dynamic hard sphere margin only, not full native acceptance.

failed_candidates.native_gate_scope: Python checks only the dynamic branch. Static/self/wheel/full native full-only verdict is not inferred.

nearby_actual_execution.scope: Actual previously consumed guide and repeatedly validated MPPI rollouts nearby in time. A failed candidate was never executed, so this does not certify that candidate. Native model gaps and physical sphere-to-synthetic-truth gaps have different boundaries.

consumed_reference_phase_evidence.scope: Only the consumed reference is associated. Feedback scale is clipped tangential velocity/reference speed, not a committed future time scaling. Geometric phase can advance during a detour without executing the polynomial.

actual_contract.authority: Repeated native-3D selected/brake rollout validation before MPPI command publication
actual_contract.progress_source: runtime/local_execution.py progress.project; state.csv trajectory_start/virtual_time/time_scale records the MPPI progress topic
actual_contract.feedback_scale_definition: clip(measured velocity dot reference tangent / max(0.02, abs(reference speed)), 0, 1)

native3d_truth_monitor.scope: independent analytic sphere vs finite cylinder/wall truth, <=5ms integration substeps; not full mesh or continuous proof
